headline: Nigerian Court Sentences Oil Executive and Former Officials to Seven Years Over $1.6B Fraud
summary: The Court of Appeal in Abuja sentenced oil businessman Olajide Jones Omokore and two former senior petroleum officials to seven years in prison each over a $1.6 billion oil fraud case.
why: High-profile anti-corruption enforcement actions involving energy executives impact corporate governance, regulatory compliance, and state-backed sector operations in emerging markets.
